episodes.title: A Bunch of Smart Orphans
episodes.summary: Four gifted orphans vie for a prestigious scholarship. The final result is stranger than imagined.

episodes.title: Carrying a Bird
episodes.summary: Mr. Benedict sends the kids on an undercover mission to infiltrate the L.I.V.E. Institute.

episodes.title: Depends on the Wagon
episodes.summary: The kids strive for academic success without revealing their investigation to Dr. Curtain.

episodes.title: A Whisper, Not a Shout
episodes.summary: Reynie and Sticky pursue the coveted Messenger status while the girls try to stay afloat in class.

episodes.title: The Art of Conveyance and Round-Trippery
episodes.summary: Reynie and Sticky are invited to join the Messengers and come face-to-face with the device behind The Emergency's secret transmissions – The Whisperer. After their previous mode of communication is compromised, Number Two suggests an alternative means of reaching the children. Kate and Constance follow a lead from Mr. Benedict to uncover a secret entrance to Dr. Curtain's lab, just as Dr. Curtain gears up to advance the next phase of his plan: The Improvement.

episodes.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
episodes.summary: Mr. Benedict reveals the truth about his past with Dr. Curtain – and how he may be partly to blame for Curtain's misdeeds. The adults agree the mission has gotten too dangerous to continue. Sticky is given a special task during Messenger duty and begins to question his loyalties. Kate and Reynie develop their respective friendships with Martina and Curtain's son, SQ, and use them to advance the mission.

episodes.title: The Dance of the Celestial Orb
episodes.summary: Kate embarks on a solo mission that raises Curtain's suspicions and endangers the team.

episodes.title: Big Day Today
episodes.summary: With free will and truth on the line, The Mysterious Benedict Society prepares for a final showdown.

episodes.title: A Perilous Journey
episodes.summary: The Mysterious Benedict Society kids must venture out on their own to find two of their leaders.

episodes.title: A Bit of Light Chop
episodes.summary: The kids stow away on a ship. Benedict and Number Two try to escape Curtain's compound.

episodes.title: A Gold Bar in Fort Knox
episodes.summary: The children make some dangerous wagers while Benedict takes a gamble with Curtain.

episodes.title: Free of Pointless Command
episodes.summary: Constance gets the kids closer to finding the compromised Mr. Benedict by using her gift.

episodes.title: Blank Expression
episodes.summary: The kids enlist an ally. Constance faces off with an old enemy. Number Two confronts Dr. Curtain.

episodes.title: Commitment to All Things Cozy
episodes.summary: The Society splits up to escape an attack. Number Two and Mr. Benedict plot against Dr. Curtain.

episodes.title: A Joyful Lens
episodes.summary: After seeing the adults acting strangely, the kids spring into action. Curtain hosts a celebration.

episodes.title: A Two-Way Street
episodes.summary: Freshly arrived at a haven from Number Two's past, The Society bands together to stave off disaster.
